definitions.explanation: A measured duration of time, especially in sports and competitions. Used for race results, personal records, and performance measurements.
A pause or break in a game or activity, called by a player, coach, or participant.

examples.english: I updated my personal best time.

notes:
From English 'time'. In Japanese, タイム is used primarily in sports and competitive contexts for measured time, and as a call for a pause. It does not replace the general Japanese word for time (⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{計|はか}る→計る：28292_hakaru⟧: to time, to measure the time
- タイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to produce/post a time
- タイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}める→縮める：04245_chijimeru⟧: to improve (shorten) one's time
- ⟦{自己|じこ}→自己：23357_jiko⟧ベストタイム: personal best time
- ⟦ラップ→ラップ：11486_rappu⟧タイム: lap time
- タイム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to call a time-out
- タイムアウト: time-out (formal)

COMPOUNDS:
- タイムセール: time-limited sale (common in Japanese retail)
- タイムカード: time card (for recording work hours)
- タイムリミット: time limit
- タイムマシン: time machine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: time — the general Japanese word for time, duration, or hour
- ⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: record — a broader term for any measured record, including time records
